# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** Around fifty to sixty-three years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott is a tall, strong man who was described in his youth as looking like a Viking of elder days. For fifteen years, he had extremely long hair and a full beard, which gave him the appearance of a dime museum freak or modern Nazarite. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he was revealed to be a handsome, middle-aged man with a strong, clean-shaven chin.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031)_

## Personality

Marshall is a stubborn, temperamental, but mighty fine man with a streak of foolishness in him. He possesses a strong sense of humor, enjoying jokes even when he is mistaken for a stranger. He is also a noted dancer and fine tenor singer who enjoys social gatherings.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P18](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0018), [v4 c35 P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027)_

## History

Marshall Elliott made a vow during a bitter election that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Liberal party won office. Over the course of fifteen years, he kept his vow, earning a reputation for looking peculiar to strangers while going fishing with Captain Jim. On New Year's Eve, he attended a gathering at Captain Jim's lighthouse, singing Scotch ballads and dancing with Leslie Moore. When the Liberals finally won the election, Marshall went straight to Augustus Palmer's barber shop at midnight and forced the reluctant barber to shave his beard and cut his hair, scaring his housekeeper when he returned home unrecognized. He later met Anne Shirley at the lighthouse clean-shaven, enjoying the joke when she failed to recognize him. Roughly a month after his transformation, he married Miss Cornelia Bryant.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c37 P25](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0025), [v4 c37 P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)_
